newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nice reports 18.6pct increase in airfreight in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Nice reports 18.6pct increase in airfreight in Oct.

text.p: Nice-Cote d'Azur airport reported an 18.6 percent increase in airfreight traffic in October compared with October last year throughput reaching 1,727 tonnes, airport authority figures showed.
"We can't point to any particular factor for the strong growth in traffic and it's probably due to a general recovery in the sector," an airport authority cargo official told Reuters.
Since mid-September 1996, United Parcel Service, has operated a weekday Lyon-Nice cargo feeder rotation using a two-tonne capacity Beechcraft 1900 aircraft.
Nice airport's January-October 1996 cargo throughput totalled 14,625 tonnes, down 8.1 percent on 1995 levels.
The Air France group generates the major part of cargo traffic handled at Nice airport.
Apart fron the UPS feeder, the only other freighter flight at the airport is a weekday DHL Worldwide Express nightly link as part of its intra-European air cargo network.
Postal traffic in the first ten months of the year was up 7.6 percent on 1995 levels at 7,312 tonnes.

French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Nice on a regular basis using Boeing 737QC aircraft. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
